question: A 243 long train running at 60 km/h takes 42 seconds to cross a tunnel. The length (in m) of the tunnel is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let length of the tunnel = L meter

⇒ ((L + 243) times 18)/(60 times 5) = 42

⇒ L + 243 = 700

⇒ L = 700 - 243 = 457 m

**∴ Length of the tunnel is 457 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

Length of the train = 243 m

Train speed = 60 km/h

Time = 42 second

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed x Time 

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

Let length of tunnel = L meter

Speed of train = 60 km/h x 5/18

⇒ ((L + 243) times 18)/(60 times 5) = 42

⇒ L + 243 = 7 x 20 x 5
